sheets.name: KPI_Dictionary
rows: Every KPI in this pack, how it is calculated and why it matters
Sum of monthly actual revenue for the fiscal year (Apr–Mar).
Revenue − direct cost; margin = GP ÷ revenue.
Delivery efficiency; first line of defence on pricing and utilisation.
Revenue − direct cost − operating expenses; margin = OI ÷ revenue.
Positive = favourable for revenue and profit lines.
On track if variance ≥ threshold (default −2%); Watch if ≥ −5%; else Off track. Margin RAG uses percentage points.
Focus management attention; thresholds are editable inputs.
Revenue ÷ average monthly headcount, shown in $K.
1 − Σ|actual − budget| ÷ Σ budget across the 30 BU × region cells.
Quality of the budgeting process, independent of offsetting errors.
A BU-region-month where operating income is >15% below budget (and budget OI > 0).
(Rev actual − Rev budget) × budget OI margin before rate changes.
Isolates how much of the OI gap is simply revenue shortfall / outperformance.
Pricing, utilisation, wage inflation, subcontract costs.
